PLAN "12-Week Program for Endometriosis Considerations"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build sustainable strength with pain-aware, low-impact structure"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Init foundation and low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Stability and glute bridging":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_bridge 60 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mobility and core control":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x30-45 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression and steady volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior chain and core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_plank 3x30-45 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Shoulders and mobility":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength block with controlled tempo":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up (assisted if needed) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Glute/hamstring and core":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5..7 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying_leg_raise 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper push/pull balance":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          overhead_stretch 60 seconds
NOTE: On flow days and flare windows (as defined), avoid HIIT, avoid heavy Valsalva, avoid jumping.
If a training day would coincide with a flare window, substitute to maintain safe load:
  - replace explosive or high-impact movements with low-impact equivalents (e.g., step-ups instead of jump squats; machine-based or cable variations instead of free weights for upper body if needed)
  - reduce volume by 20-30% and maintain RPE around 6-7
  - ensure longer rest (120 seconds) between sets as needed
SENSITIVITY PLAN:
  - Use walking and cycling in warmups where possible
  - Prioritize pain-free ranges of motion; avoid end-range discomfort
  - Track symptoms and adjust weekly as needed

END PLAN

NUTRITION PLAN
  TITLE "Anti-Inflammatory Nutrition to Support Endometriosis Management"
  GOALS
    GOAL primary nutrition:
      name "Reduce systemic inflammation, support recovery, and stable energy"
  GUIDELINES
    - Emphasize whole, minimally processed foods with colorful fruits and vegetables daily.
    - Prioritize omega-3 rich foods: fatty fish (salmon, mackerel, sardines) 2–3 times/week; flaxseeds, chia seeds, walnuts.
    - Favor extra-virgin olive oil as primary fat source; include avocado regularly.
    - Include lean proteins at each meal: poultry, fish, eggs, legumes, tofu.
    - Choose complex carbohydrates: oats, quinoa, brown rice, sweet potatoes, whole grains; pair with fiber-rich veggies.
    - Aim to 2–3 servings of non-starchy vegetables per day per meal window; include at least 1 fruit serving daily.
    - Limit added sugars and highly processed snacks; minimize ultra-processed foods.
    - Limit saturated fats; avoid trans fats.
    - Hydration: 2–3 liters/day depending on activity; limit added caffeinated beverages to moderate levels.
    - Optional anti-inflammatory herbs/spices: turmeric (with black pepper), ginger, garlic, cinnamon.
  SCHEDULE
    - Breakfast: high-protein option + fiber + healthy fats (e.g., Greek yogurt with berries, chia seeds, and almonds; or eggs with sautéed veggies and avocado).
    - Lunch: lean protein + vegetables + whole grain + olive oil (e.g., grilled chicken, quinoa, mixed greens with olive oil vinaigrette).
    - Dinner: balanced plate similar to lunch; include a serving of fatty fish 2–3 times weekly.
    - Snacks: fruit with a handful of nuts; hummies with veggie sticks; yogurt with seeds.
  DAILY MACROS (adjustable by client preference; approximate range)
    - Protein: 1.2–1.6 g/kg body weight
    - Fat: 25–40% of total calories, focusing on monounsaturated and omega-3 fats
    - Carbohydrates: remainder of calories, prioritize fiber-rich sources
  SUPPLEMENTS (consult clinician before use)
    - Consider a daily omega-3 supplement (e.g., 1000–2000 mg EPA+DHA) if dietary intake is low
    - Vitamin D3 1000–2000 IU daily if deficient or low sun exposure (after clinician guidance)
    - Magnesium 200–400 mg at night if muscle tension or sleep is an issue
  FLOW-DAY CONSIDERATIONS
    - On days with higher symptoms, ensure consistent protein intake and hydration; keep meals gentle and easy-to-digest if needed
  MEAL TIMING
    - Try to maintain regular meal timing (every 3–4 hours) to support energy and satiety
  MONITORING
    - Track symptoms and energy, and adjust portions or food choices weekly to maintain steady energy and minimize GI discomfort
  NOTES
    - The nutrition plan supplements the training program and is not a substitute for medical advice. Seek guidance from a registered dietitian for personalized caloric targets and nutrient needs.

END PLAN

        main straight_sets:

          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

  - replace explosive or high-impact movements with low-impact equivalents (e.g., step-ups instead of jump squats; machine-based or cable variations instead of free weights for upper body if needed)
  - reduce volume by 20-30% and maintain RPE around 6-7
  - ensure longer rest (120 seconds) between sets as needed
SENSITIVITY PLAN:
  - Use walking and cycling in warmups where possible
  - Prioritize pain-free ranges of motion; avoid end-range discomfort
  - Track symptoms and adjust weekly as needed
CARDIO PROGRESSION
  - Week 1–4: accumulate 60–120 minutes of cardio per week, split across 2–3 sessions; mostly low-to-moderate intensity (talk test)
  - Week 5–8: increase to 120–180 minutes per week; include one longer steady-state session 30–40 minutes
  - Week 9–12: target 150–210 minutes per week; add one optional light intervals session if pain permitting (e.g., 1–2 minutes hard, 2 minutes easy, total 15–20 minutes)
  - Intensity guidelines: aim for RPE 4–6 (some days 6) during cardio, avoid breath-holding; monitor abdominal/pelvic comfort
END PLAN

  - Week 9–12: target 150–210 minutes per week; add one optional light intervals session if pain permitting (e.g., 1–2 minutes hard, 2 minutes easy, total 15–20 minutes)
  - Intensity guidelines: aim for RPE 4–6 (some days 6) during cardio, avoid breath-holding; monitor abdominal/pelvic comfort
END PLAN
